notes.title: New game! Damsels of Vice 2: Project Mesmer!
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41848295/cd3702cdd061842423b1523cd34202f760c871e1.png

The bustling metropolis, Infinity City, is in grave danger once again as rumors of a dangerous, unknown plot called "Project Mesmer" start to circulate. It's up to two of Infinity City's quirkiest superheroines to step in and save the day... but there's just one problem: their enemies can turn them into giggly, jiggly, sex-crazed BIMBOS! Will they be able to fight against their basest of instincts to conquer evil, or will they give in to become it?

Damsels of Vice is back and better than ever in this exciting new sequel! Play as two brand new superheroines and investigate the mysterious "Project Mesmer." You'll come across familiar faces and fresh new foes in your quest to save Infinity City from a new plot that will surely bring it to ruin.


 You can now be a bimbo both in and out of combat! Depending on your status, people will treat you and events will play out differently.
 The revamped Action Sequence system offers many super changes, including enhanced feedback to ensure that you know exactly what happens when you press a button.
 Power Up! System returns with new and exciting skills for your heroines to learn.
 All new Perils including mummification and hypnosis.


For more information, screenshots, the gameplay trailer and more, check out the store page:
https://subsupreme.itch.io/dov2-projectmesmer

Damsels of Vice 2: Project Mesmer will be coming to Steam soon! I'll have more information on a specific date once things get rolling on that front. Based on the time it usually takes to implement stuff like Achievements combined with the approval process and waiting period, I expect it to arrive here in about 3-4 weeks. I'll be sure to keep fans updated as we get closer to a concrete date!
